title: a harness word that the splitter reads as a command is denied even when it is only text: a known limit, the session puts the text in a file
source: intended: docs/decisions.md A3 (defect N-24): the segment splitter reads text after ( , a backtick or a newline as a command, the way jitso build save has the same limit
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-24, owner answer A3), a known limit pinned on purpose. The guard splits a command line at parentheses, backticks and newlines without reading quotes, so a commit message or a heredoc line that starts with claude after one of those is judged as a command and denied. The deny text tells the session to put such text in a file and pass the file. The TS binary prints nothing for these lines, so the decision FAILS on TS.
